intro: Turquoise water, coral reefs and white sand. That is Andaman Islands in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Andaman Islands
paragraphs: Andaman Islands (Andaman & Nicobar) is known for its beach, diving and island experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to April.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Cellular Jail light and sound show

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly to Port Blair, then take a ferry to Havelock and Neil.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Book inter-island ferries early in peak season — they sell out.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Andaman Islands?
How do I reach Andaman Islands?
faq.a: Fly to Port Blair, then take a ferry to Havelock and Neil.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Andaman Islands?
faq.a: Popular choices: Havelock for beaches and diving; Neil for slow island life; Port Blair for transit nights.
